mae.f: (business, mergers and acquisitions) Initialism of material adverse effect.

s.g: A generous benefactor; specifically, a patron of literature or art.
(Greek mythology, also attributive) A female follower of Dionysus (“the god of wine”), associated with intense revelling.
(by extension, literary, derogatory) An excessively emotional or wild woman.
(music) A passage to be played majestically.
(chiefly music) A master in some art, especially a composer or conductor.
